comments.content: The ES_VERSION_6 constants are incorrectly set to version 5 values. `ES_VERSION_6` is `"5"` (should be `"6"`) and `ES_VERSION_6_STANDARD_TOKEN_FILTER` is `"5_custom_analyzer"` (should be `"6_custom_analyzer"`). This means RestoreFromVersion6IT and RestoreFromVersion6CustomAnalyzerIT (and the corresponding Mount tests) will actually restore the v5 snapshots instead of v6, so the v6 snapshot zips (snapshot_v6_custom_analyzer.zip) are never exercised. The comments also incorrectly say "Index created in vES_5".
